title: test(dogfood): pin the last access-security checklist clauses at the oracle's layer, slice 4
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8YSjPf3hTSLEBa52VUBikb4)_

Fixes #26571 (slice 4 of 4, items: access-security.parent-and-organization-write-guards, access-security.deployment-tables-platform-only, access-security.share-link-combined-gates)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：access-security 区最后 3 个清单条目补上 dogfood 断言（进程内 HTTP，即这些条款 oracle 指定的层），新增 3 个隔离用例文件，共钉住 8 条此前只在引擎层或单元层的条款。3 个条目的 `automated.ref` 逐条款改写，其中 deployment-tables-platform-only 和 share-link-combined-gates 的 `automated.kind` 改为 `dogfood`；每个条目 `revision` 加一、`history` 记本卡。本片之后 #26571 无剩余条目。
- 为什么改：18.2.0 Tier 1 记录 #26468 把这 3 条判为 PARTIAL：组织字段清空拒绝、表头存在性对等、部署级表的两类人员、分享链接组合关卡，都没有走 HTTP 的断言。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和改清单文字，不动产品代码，不加 CI 通道。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `parent-and-organization-write-guards.dogfood.test.ts`（posture-only 隔离启动下清空 organization_id 被 403，以及不可读与不存在表头返回相同 400）；② `share-link-combined-gates.dogfood.test.ts`（匿名各变体字节级相同的拒绝体，/resolve 与 /messages 配对）；③ Acceptance notes 里关于 controlled_by_parent 明细返回 403 而非 400 的说明。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/qa/dogfood && pnpm exec vitest run test/parent-and-organization-write-guards.dogfood.test.ts`（需先按 dogfood 惯例 build 依赖闭包），预期 `Tests 6 passed`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Each clause is pinned at the layer its oracle names: `api` is the in-process HTTP stack of `@objectstack/verify`. All changes are in `packages/qa/dogfood/**` plus the area ledger, with no product code changes. Every new assertion was written against today's behaviour and is green. All three files boot their own showcase (isolated), since each writes records, mints links or creates an organization.

| item | clauses newly pinned | where |
|---|---|---|
| parent-and-organization-write-guards | acceptance[1], [2], negative[0] | New `parent-and-organization-write-guards`. acceptance[1]: a `multiTenant: 'posture-only'` boot (the tenancy service reports `isolated`, the wall active and not degraded, asserted). An organization owner who is not the platform administrator PATCHes their own `showcase_private_note` with `organization_id: null` and gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`; the row keeps its organization, and the same caller's PATCH that leaves the column alone is admitted. Inserts sending `organization_id` `null` and `''` are stamped with the caller's active organization. acceptance[2] / negative[0]: a member holding a scratch set that writes `showcase_task` and whose row policy selects no `showcase_project` POSTs a task naming a seeded project it cannot read (asserted) and one naming a project id that exists nowhere. Both answer 400 with `reference_not_found`, and the bodies are equal field by field once the named id is normalised. Nothing lands, and the admin's identical POST lands. The same parity is measured on the `controlled_by_parent` invoice line, as described in the Acceptance notes |
| deployment-tables-platform-only | acceptance[1], [2] | New `deployment-tables-platform-only`. A Default Organization member's `sys_member` role is promoted to `admin`. A guard asserts it resolves an `organization_admin` set, holds no `manage_platform_settings`, and is not the platform administrator. On each of the seven tables (`sys_job`, `sys_job_queue`, `sys_job_run`, `sys_migration`, `sys_migration_journal`, `sys_flow_dispatch`, `sys_presence`), `GET /api/v1/data/TABLE` is 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` for the org admin and 200 for the platform administrator. The platform administrator's URL-encoded `organization_id` filter is 400 `INVALID_FIELD` on each |
| share-link-combined-gates | acceptance[1], [2], [3], negative[0] | New `share-link-combined-gates`. The admin mints two links through `POST /api/v1/share-links` on the seeded published client brief. Link A (`signed_in` + password), resolved anonymously with no password, a wrong one and the right one (UTF-8 header form), answers 401 `SIGN_IN_REQUIRED` with three byte-identical bodies. Link B (`email` + password) answers 404 `INVALID_OR_EXPIRED` to five non-entitled variants, byte-identical with an unknown token's body; the allowlisted email with the right password resolves 200. The same eight calls are paired with `/messages`: 404 `NOT_FOUND` wherever `/resolve` refused, and 400 `UNSUPPORTED` on the one call it passed |

Ledger:

- Each of the three items gets a rewritten `automated.ref` that maps clauses to cases, `revision` +1, and a `history` row citing #26571.
- deployment-tables-platform-only moves from `automated.kind` `unit` to `dogfood`, and share-link-combined-gates moves from `conformance` to `dogfood`, since each ref now leads with the dogfood pin. parent-and-organization-write-guards was already `dogfood`.

Clauses left as they are, each with its reason in the item's `automated.ref`:

- Every item's acceptance[0] is the pin run itself (`test` oracle).
- parent-and-organization-write-guards acceptance[3] was already pinned over HTTP by `cbp-parent-attachment-comment-gates` and `cbp-explain-master-write`.

No clause is left as a live leg.

## Tests

On head `bc2b4dce` (origin/main merged), with the closure rebuilt, the three new files ran under `os-verify-lock`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 25 passed (25)` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). That is 15 in deployment-tables-platform-only, 4 in share-link-combined-gates and 6 in parent-and-organization-write-guards. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. The final merge of main, right before this PR, brought crud-permission-matrix's ledger row (#26923, no overlap with these three items), app-shell fixes, docs, and two runtime/metadata-protocol refusals that none of these doors read. The full dogfood battery is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- parent-and-organization-write-guards acceptance[2]: on the `controlled_by_parent` line (`showcase_invoice_line`), a stock contributor naming another contributor's invoice and one naming a missing invoice both get the ADR-0055 §3 master-edit gate's 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`. That gate runs before the reference check. The two bodies are byte-identical, so negative[0] holds there, and the file pins that. The 400 `reference_not_found` comparison is pinned on `showcase_task`, a plain `master_detail` detail of `showcase_project`. That matches `engine-unreadable-master-detail-header.test.ts`, whose controls keep a `controlled_by_parent` detail unchanged. If the item's clause is meant to require 400 on the `controlled_by_parent` fixture too, that is a clause question for the seat, not a pin gap.
- parent-and-organization-write-guards acceptance[2]: every showcase member reads projects through the stock baseline. So the scratch set narrows `showcase_project` with a row policy that selects nothing, and a guard asserts the member's by-id read is refused.
- The item's knownGaps about provisioning a walled `os serve` boot are unchanged. They describe the live run's fixture. The pin uses the in-process `posture-only` walled boot that `no-active-organization-write-refusal` and `wall-catalog-refusal` already use.

## Verification

Local gate subset on head `bc2b4dce` (origin/main merged): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 55 families. All 55 ran and exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Repository-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full dogfood battery) are CI's.

`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.

Changeset: none. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private and `docs/qa/**` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
